name: Curse of Altered Perceptions — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Curse of Altered Perceptions from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Curse of Altered Perceptions" but are not part of the Curse of Altered Perceptions entry, which is unchanged.

Illusory Maneuvers (Su)

The curse of altered perceptions makes it difficult for your foes to track your movements. You gain Improved Feint as a bonus feat. If there is an active illusion spell on you or within 10 feet, you gain a +4 bonus to the attempt to feint. At 8th level, you may attempt a feint as a swift action if affected by or within 10 feet of an active illusion spell.

Phantasmal Flanker (Su)

Upon striking a foe in melee, you impart a fraction of your curse causing the target to hallucinate and see a phantasmal copy of you attacking them. The target creature must make a Will save or be considered flanked until they are next attacked or for 1 minute, whichever is sooner. Additionally, on a failed save, the target is unsure which of the targets is real for the duration of the effect. This is treated as if you had the mirror image spell with one image. At 5th level and every 5 levels thereafter, you gain an additional image. Hitting the target multiple times does not create more images but restarts the duration of the previous images assuming the target fails their Will save. If the target is affected by this ability, you cannot use this ability for 1 minute or until you or another within 10 feet cast an illusion spell. If the target is unaffected, you need not wait to use the ability again. This is an illusion, phantasm) effect.

Mislead (Sp)

Prerequisite(s) 10th level or higher

You gain the spell mislead as a spell-like ability usable once per day. You may deliver this spell as part of your cursed strike ability, meaning the spell is triggered on yourself when hitting your target. E.g., you turn invisible and the target thinks you’re behind them. You gain an additional use at 18th level.

Reality Shifting (Su)

You can focus your curse as a swift action to change the appearance of specific parts of reality. You can concentrate to duplicate the effects of a silent image or disguise selfspell effect on any creature or space within the radius of your curse manifestation. This can change the appearance of walls, create walls or other terrain features, change the appearance of any creature in the area, etc. While maintaining this effect, you cannot cast any spells or use any other curse abilities, otherwise, there is no duration. You may affect 1 5-foot square worth of terrain and/or creatures and objects per 2 lathspell class levels at any one time. At 3rd level, you can add sound to any of the effects as per the minor image spell. At 5th level, you may also add in thermal and olfactory effects per the major image spell. At 7th level, you may add in tactile figments or change the appearance of objects. Shifting the areas affected by this ability is a swift action, but ending the effect is a free action. Creatures interacting with this effect are allowed a Will save to disbelieve it. This is an illusion, figment, and glamer effect.

Spontaneous Terrain (Su)

Prerequisite(s) 6th level or higher

You can, as an immediate action, cause an enemy to believe the terrain they are traversing is precarious and difficult terrain. The target may make a Will save after their first 5 feet of movement through the difficult terrain to disbelieve the remainder of the illusory obstructions. This is an illusion, phantasm) effect.

Walking Curse
Echo of Reality (Su)

What is reality but perception; you have been shifted, displaced, hidden, and projected so frequently by your curse that it begins to fray at the very reality of your being. Your body shifts in and out of reality granting you 20% concealment, though this does not prevent precision damage as you are still in the same place when in reality and your physiology does not change. However, this special concealment extends to harmful spells and effects that target you that do not have an attack roll. Additionally, all illusion spells cast upon you have their caster-level increased by 2, including spells you cast yourself.
